subject: general
question: Who administers oath of office to the Vice President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The President of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Vice President's oath **is administered by the **President of India.**
 
• The office of the **Vice President** is the **second-highest constitutional post in India**.
 
• **Article 63** mentions the Vice President of India's position. It states that there shall be a Vice President of India.<
